This is an excellent opportunity to work with a diverse range of late-model vehicles in a professional, fast-paced workshop environment.   Benefits   Competitive salary of $79,500 – $82,000 plus superannuation.  Stable, full-time employment.  Opportunity to work on a modern fleet of rental vehicles.  Ongoing training and professional development.  Supportive team environment with opportunities for career progression.  Convenient Perth Airport location.    Task & responsibilities   Diagnosing mechanical and electrical faults using specialised diagnostic equipment.  Carrying out routine servicing, maintenance, and repairs on petrol, diesel, and hybrid vehicles.  Testing and repairing engines, transmissions, steering systems, suspension, braking systems, and other vehicle components.  Performing scheduled maintenance in accordance with manufacturer specifications.  Removing, repairing, replacing, and reassembling defective parts and components.  Conducting vehicle inspections and road tests to ensure repairs meet safety and performance standards.  Maintaining accurate service records and reporting repair requirements.  Ensuring all work complies with workplace health and safety procedures and industry standards.  Assisting in maintaining workshop tools, equipment, and a clean, organised work environment.  Working collaboratively with the workshop team to ensure timely turnaround of fleet vehicles.    Qualification & experience   Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent qualification.  At least one year of relevant full-time post-qualification experience (or equivalent).  Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills.  Experience servicing a wide range of passenger vehicles.   About Company    MRP Industries Pty Ltd is a Western Australian automotive service provider specialising in the maintenance, servicing, and repair of passenger vehicles.
